question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: The founders met at a Harvard startup mixer in 2023 and immediately bonded over fintech. They stayed in touch as friends and idea sparring partners, and later realized that advances in AI and new platform unlocks made Uno Wallet a massive opportunity to build together in the infrastructure and fintech space.
